summary: Exyn Technologies filed an 8-K reporting a confidential side letter agreement with creditor Evergreen Capital Management. The agreement defers default on a Note and Warrant Purchase Agreement by restructuring payment of an outstanding balance, default penalty, and accrued interest into three monthly installments totaling $1,417,164.99, with the first $472,388.33 due June 17, 2026. Exyn also issued 100,000 equity kicker shares. No additional liquidated damages or penalty interest apply. This is a forbearance and debt repayment arrangement, not a transformative special situation; it does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or strategic review.
